name: Bitbucket Status
about: Bitbucket publishes its own incidents on a public status page. We count incidents, leaving out those marked as having no impact, and do not store or publish incident text.
attribution: Counts derived from the public Bitbucket status page.
limitations: Incidents are self-reported, so a company that reports more honestly can look worse.
New products add new ways to have an incident, so counts can rise without reliability getting worse.
